item.title: First Tesla Cybercab rolls off the production line: Here's what to expect
item.description: The first Tesla Cybercab has officially rolled off the floor at Tesla Gigafactory Texas, and yes, it comes without a steering wheel or pedals. It will operate entirely on Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) system, and it seems we’re not far off from mass production either.Continue ReadingCategory: Automotive, TransportTags: Tesla Motors, Autonomous Vehicles, Taxi, urban transport, Self-Driving, Tesla, Elon Musk, Waymo, Uber, Cabs

item.title: Google spinoff beams blazing-fast internet around cities using light
item.description: Over the last few years, an ambitious moonshot project spun out of Google has been developing fascinating technologies to deliver connectivity across communities without the need for underground cables. For its latest trick, Taara is now providing high-speed internet access across cities using invisible beams of light.Continue ReadingCategory: Telecommunications, TechnologyTags: Taara, Alphabet, Fiber optics, Internet, Broadband

item.description: Indian studio Sanjay Puri Architects dreamed up plans for a university that are quite unlike the usual imposing structures that immediately come to mind. item.title: 2026 DesertX gets Ducati's lightest twin-cylinder engine ever
item.description: Six years after Ducati launched the first-gen DesertX, the company has given its beloved adventure motorcycle a major overhaul, with a view to enhancing off-road performance. From the details and specs we've seen, there are both thoughtful updates and possibly controversial trade-offs for fans of the outgoing model – but it's said to all be in service of making the DesertX more enjoyable for riders of all skill levels.Continue ReadingCategory: Motorcycles, TransportTags: Ducati, Adventure Bikes

item.title: Bonkers omnidirectional electric 'bike' balances on a single ball wheel
item.description: British inventor and YouTuber James Bruton has a habit of solving problems nobody asked him to solve – and then solving them again, harder. The man behind the screw-drive motorcycle (yes, it moves on spinning cylinders instead of wheels) and a rideable electric Lego skateboard has now tackled what might be his most deranged engineering flex yet: an electric moto that balances on a single giant ball.Continue ReadingCategory: Urban Transport, TransportTags: Self-balancing, Oddball, Inventors, Unic

item.title: Torquey adventure ebike auto engages mid-drive muscle to tame trails
item.description: California's Aventon has built its reputation over the years as a builder of value-driven commuter and urban ebikes. Recently, though, the company has been edging further into trail territory. The new Ramblas ADV marks its most confident step in that direction to date, taking its Aventure M blueprint to the next level with a hardtail electric bike centered around a fresh mid-drive system.Continue ReadingCategory: Bicycles, TransportTags: ebikes, Pedal-assisted, Off-road, Mountain Bikes

item.description: In what may be a hint of things to come or a subtle act of disinformation, Pratt & Whitney has released a video possibly featuring a tantalizing new image of the Boeing F-47 sixth-generation fighter plane being developed for the US Air Force to replace the F-22.Continue ReadingCategory: Military, TechnologyTags: Pratt & Whitney, Aircraft, Fighter, F-47, US Air Force, Boeing

item.description: News about intermittent fasting seems to change as frequently as the apps on your phone need upgrading. item.title: 28-ft tiny house hits sweet spot between portability and livability
item.description: With its length of 28 ft (8.5 m), the Betty sits in a nice mid-size spot that's a good compromise between portability and spaciousness. The tiny house also provides a well-planned interior layout designed for two, including a proper ground-floor bedroom and a loft for storage.Continue ReadingCategory: Tiny Houses, OutdoorsTags: Building and Construction, Tiny Footprint, Micro-House, House, Home

item.title: Gerber retools camp multi-plier to bridge backcountry with backyard
item.description: Since launching the Stakeout as a base camp multitool in 2022, Gerber has been growing out the family with new tools and tweaks. Last year, it doubled down on the Stakeout's camping focus with the fire-starting Stakeout Spark. Now it's released a variant that seamlessly shifts from weekday DIY tasks to weekend adventures. The all-new Stakeout Drive brings a versatile direct-access bit driver to the folding multi-plier format.Continue ReadingCategory: Knives and Multitools, Gear, OutdoorsTags: Mu
